_doc: Mondlicht's living world (UPDATE 10 §3 Act IV, contract C1, DECISIONS T-158): read by MapAmbience (MapRoot attaches it because this file exists); its `# ---- U10 Act IV ----` block hands these sections to a MondlichtLiving node (gravelight/world/map04/mondlicht_living.gd). Presentation only. needs_landscape false: the Moon has no Landscape and none of Map 0's kinds (bombers, artillery, crows...) are listed, so none run. dust_settle: a slow puff where a shot hits the regolith or the rim in the open (max_per_s, a pool of emitters, lifetime s, gravity m/s² for the puff, max_y: only hits this low; range_m of the ray). crater_shadows: the Sun swings with the terminator (Terminator), so the long shadows move; earthshine_gain lifts the yard's earthshine fill as the night grows. relay_mast: the mast beacon's pulse period (the dish's red warning lamp blinks in time). vacuum_muffle: AudioDirector's suit muffle on the SFX bus while in a vacuum zone (cutoff_hz, db). earth_violet: the Earth's violet points breathe (breath 0..1). field_units: Darkmatter's field units (constructs, never people) walking just beyond the north rim along path (feet at 2.4 m: the 3 m rim hides the legs, the bodies and lamps show over it) at speed m/s, spacing_m apart, lamps on (the Bar's row 19 on the Moon). meteors: distant silent streaks every interval s.
